Problem Statement
Write a C program that manages and analyzes a dynamically sized array of floating-point numbers. The program should:

Take(read) the size of the array from the user.
Declare and initialize an array of the specified size.
Populate(fill) the array with user-input floating-point numbers.
Perform these following operations and display the results:
Calculate the average of the numbers.
Compute the maximum and minimum numbers present in the array.
Compute the standard deviation of the numbers.

Input:
An integer n (size of the array, where 1 <= n <= 100).
n floating-point numbers.

Output:
The average of the numbers with two decimal precision.
The maximum number in the array.
The minimum number in the array.
The standard deviation of the numbers with two decimal precision.
